chunks.text: Payments Migration Status: COMPLETE. All checkout traffic is routed through Stripe v2 and legacy v1 endpoints are decommissioned. Feature flag PAYMENTS_V2_ENABLED is enabled by default.

TASK-88,Verify webhook dead-letter queue replay after idempotency fix,blocked,,No assignee set yet
TASK-89,Rotate Stripe v2 webhook signing secret before 100% rollout,todo,Maya Lin,Pending rotation

Feature flags live in infra/flags.yaml. Alert stripe_v2_retry_5xx triggers when webhook retry failures exceed 2% over 5 minutes. Stripe v2 webhook signing secret rotation is scheduled before 100% rollout.
